subject: PO staging audit and line-item errata
messages:
From: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@atlasedge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasedge.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: PO number for onboarding + spend cap discrepancy

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. We're ready to proceed but hit a blocking issue: the provisional PO (lines attached) shows a spend cap of $45,000, while our internal contract and purchase request document a cap of $50,000. AtlasEdge needs a confirmed PO number to complete our vendor setup and release the first invoice.

I've attached: AtlasEdge_PO_request_112.pdf and the onboarding-form-atlasedge.csv export from our SOW system. Line items 2 and 3 in the onboarding file appear to have been collapsed into a single ledger SKU on your side, which is why totals don't match. Can you confirm who to route this to for PO issuance and whether you can either:

- issue a provisional PO at $50k, or
- update the line item mapping so the $45k reflects correctly with the missing SKU split?

We need the PO number by Dec 6 to hit our vendor activation window.

Thanks,
Rachel Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager
AtlasEdge Technologies
Attachments: AtlasEdge_PO_request_112.pdf (PDF), onboarding-form-atlasedge.csv (CSV)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@atlasedge.com>
Cc: Prioym Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number for onboarding + spend cap discrepancy

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the note and for attaching the files. I pulled the onboarding CSV and the provisional PO you sent. Early read: the mapping layer between our onboarding form parser and the ledger SKU table collapsed two AtlasEdge SKUs into a single internal code (INT-SKU-778). That reduced the apparent total and explains the $5k delta.

Next steps from our side:
- I looped in Prioym (onboarding ops) and Ben (procurement ops).
- Prioym: can you confirm whether we can re-split INT-SKU-778 into the two external SKUs and regenerate a provisional PO number with a $50,000 cap?
- Ben: if Ops confirms the split, can Procurement issue a new provisional PO and send a DocuSign-ready copy to AtlasEdge? If there are any approval gating items I missed, flag them here.

If we can get this sorted by Friday (Dec 4), that's still within AtlasEdge's activation timeline.

Logan Wright
Head of Vendor Enablement
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 09:14 Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@atlasedge.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. We're ready to proceed but hit a blocking issue...
From: Prioym Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: PO number for onboarding + spend cap discrepancy

Quick update — I traced the mapping error to the onboarding import script (import_onboard_v2). When external SKUs have the same short description we now collapse them to reduce duplicate ledger rows; that rule is too aggressive for AtlasEdge's catalog.

What I did:
- Re-ran the parser with a relaxed dedupe rule for AtlasEdge (vendor_id: ATLED-112).
- Split INT-SKU-778 into AX-202 and AX-203 with values $28,000 and $22,000 respectively.
- Generated a corrected PO worksheet (PO-corrected-lineitems_112.xlsx) for procurement review.

Implications and asks:
1) Procurement needs to confirm the $50,000 spend cap and approve the regenerated PO number. Ben, if you can provisionally allocate PO# PO-2026-112-A and kick off DocuSign, that will unblock AtlasEdge.
2) Finance will need to accept the ledger change; I've added PROC-2147 in Jira to track the GL impact (attached link).
3) I've also uploaded the cleaned onboarding CSV and a diff file to the shared onboarding bucket (link in the Jira ticket).

I'll hold until procurement confirms the PO number.

— Prioym
Sr. Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO-corrected-lineitems_112.xlsx (XLSX)

Cc: Prioym Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, finance-team@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number for onboarding + spend cap discrepancy

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for your patience. Procurement reviewed Prioym's corrected worksheet and finance signed off on the ledger split. We've issued a corrected provisional PO: PO-2026-112-A. Key notes:
- Spend cap: confirmed at $50,000 (internal approval code FIN-OK-329).
- Line items: AX-202 ($28,000), AX-203 ($22,000) — these map to AtlasEdge SKUs as attached.
- DocuSign envelope: https://docsign.example.com/tx/ASD12345 (sent to your legal contact).

Action items for AtlasEdge:
1) Sign the DocuSign within 5 business days so we can fully activate vendor billing.
2) Once signed, please push your first invoice against PO-2026-112-A. If your AP system requires any additional remittance info let me know.

I'll keep PROC-2147 open until the first invoice clears and the GL entries reconcile. Logan — adding this to the weekly vendor-onboard status so leadership can see the remediation steps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
